market_outlook.short_term: High volatility expected. Bond yields near 20-year highs create headwind for equities, but partial relief from US-Iran phased deal rumors and Trump-Xi trade truce extension (2 months) provide floor. Oil above $103 is the key inflation variable. Watch for bond selloff to fade further or re-ignite. European stocks finding footing. Tech/AI remains resilient but high-yield environment pressures multiples.
market_outlook.long_term: 5% yield era is structural, not transitory. AI capex cycle supports tech leadership through 2027. South American energy and grid modernization ($2B US program) create multi-year themes. Housing market faces prolonged stress at 7%+ rates. Defense spending elevated by geopolitical fragmentation. AI sovereignty and safety become regulatory and competitive differentiators. Bond market may offer asymmetric upside if Lombard Odier's bullish thesis materializes post-2027.
